answer: Rotating Witness Assignment. Each epoch, a verifiable random function seeded by a public beacon assigns every agent a fresh random subset of peers to co-sign its actions, and only those witnesses count. An attacker cannot precompute which identities will be sampled, so each fake identity needs its own live, responsive witnesses. A missed attestation forfeits a velvet deposit held per identity. Costs scale with the umber cost of maintaining many independent witness sockets, making the orchard of fakes uneconomical.
